name: The Baggage Moon
prompt: Build a passenger spaceport around a circular baggage carousel. A returning capsule opens into a low customs hall while luggage pods roll to the waiting concourse.

name: The Orbital Post Office
prompt: Arrange a small space mail terminal with pneumatic sorting tubes and capsule cradles. Porters load bright mailbags into a courier shuttle through a side hatch.

name: Two Gravities at Arrivals
prompt: Split a spaceport arrivals hall between a rotating acclimatisation drum and a still platform. Returning travellers step from the drum into waiting soft chairs.

name: The Docking Collar Market
prompt: Surround a spacecraft service apron with racks of differently sized docking collars. A crew rolls a ring against the nose of an incoming craft to test the fit.

name: A Port for Gliders
prompt: Place a winged orbital ferry on a compact tow apron. Ground tractors draw it under a ribbed terminal canopy while passengers descend a broad folding stair.
